# Build a Jetpack

## Where is the options page?

The [player options page for Build a Jetpack](../player-options)
contains all the options you need to configure and export a config file.

## What is the goal of Build a Jetpack when randomized?

Reach the star high in the sky. This requires receiving three Jetpack items.

## Which items can be in another player's world?

Every upgrade (diving equipment, raft expansions, etc.) is shuffled into the item pool and can be found as an item.

## What is considered a location check in Build a Jetpack?

Buying upgrades sends location checks. If the option is enabled, selling unique types of fish for the first time will also send location checks.

## What does another world's item look like in Build a Jetpack?

Currently, items are not listed until they are sent. This may change in the future.

# Build a Jetpack Randomizer Setup Guide

## Required Software

- The Client folder from the release
- A web browser

### What is a YAML file and why do I need one?

See the guide on setting up a basic YAML at the Archipelago setup
guide: [Basic Multiworld Setup Guide](/tutorial/Archipelago/setup/en)

### Where do I get a YAML file?

You can customize your options by visiting the [Build a Jetpack Player Settings Page](../player-options)

## Joining a MultiWorld Game

### Launching the Build a Jetpack Client

The index.html file in the Client folder can be opened in any web browser, then submit the Hostname, Port, and Name for the connection

An example:
* Hostname: archipelago.gg
* Port: 38281
* Name: Player1

You will then see a `Connected` message showing that you have connected properly, and you can continue to play the game.

### Running the game

The game can be played before or after Connecting, but make sure if you are switching slots to reset the game so that your inventory and sent locations are not carried over into the new slot
